Kathrine Vox
Reach users wherever they are with
a single unified platformSENDQUICK CONVERSA FEATURES
SendQuick Conversa Portal BenefitsSendQuick Conversa Portal lets you quickly and easily chat with 
your customers on all the major chat platforms.
Easy Configuration
We provide a step-by-step guide and support throughout your entire 
onboarding process for all supported chat messengers and 
collaboration tools.No account limits when you use our service
All conversation threads will be displayed to all relevant 
department agents in a centralised platform with a single 
interface.
We do not limit any number of channels or accounts you 
wish to connect to.
